topic: Packet data logging requirements and schema review
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on enhancing the packet capture capabilities. Specifically, it was proposed that the router should log not only its own addressed data packets but also other non-addressed data packets (not probes) visible on the same channel. Furthermore, there was a request to add fields for packet type, subtype, and sequence number to the captured data.

This enhancement would require increasing the data volume and potentially modifying existing database schemas. The need to stabilize the schema was highlighted due to current inconsistencies in handling variable-length arrays (e.g., sometimes needing an array of 'n' values vs. 'n+1', with added members placed inconsistently).

[p1] questioned the necessity of logging packet types and subtypes, asking what analytical value they would provide.
decisions: The team agreed to attempt adding type, subtype, and sequence number fields to the captured data.
action_items: Someone needs to stabilize the current data schema structure due to inconsistencies in array handling.
